summary: Fireworks for Startups gives eligible startups build credits (amount unpublished) usable for serverless text/vision inference, image generation, STT, embeddings, fine-tuning and on-demand GPU deployments — credits expire 1 year after grant — plus higher rate-limit options, applied-AI expert access and community. Eligibility: registered privately-held for-profit company founded within the last 5 years, venture backed with >$500k funding, pre-Series D. Credits cover on-demand usage only, not reserved GPU/compute commitments or SLAs, professional services, or premium support. The application requires an existing Fireworks Account ID, company/website details, investors, and a work email matching the company website domain. Startup marketing describes seamless PAYG after credits if a payment method is added, but current self-serve billing docs require purchased prepaid credits and pause at zero unless Auto Reload is enabled; a card alone is not a promise of continued usage. As of 2026-10-27 the program page and fireworks.ai/startup-program redirect to a general startups marketing page without credit terms or an application form, so confirm the program is still accepting applications (startups@fireworks.ai) before relying on it.
claim_steps: Create a Fireworks account and locate its Account ID before applying. Use a work email whose domain matches the company website.
Apply through the Fireworks startup program application. As of 2026-10-27 fireworks.ai/startup-program redirects to a page with no form; contact startups@fireworks.ai to confirm how to apply.
Eligibility: registered privately held for-profit company with a functional website, founded within five years, VC-backed with over $500K raised, and not Series D or later.
On approval, use the credits within one year for eligible on-demand usage; reserved GPU/compute commitments, SLAs, professional services and premium support are excluded.

Before continuing after depletion, confirm your billing arrangement. Current self-serve docs require prepaid purchased credits; usage pauses at zero without Auto Reload. A payment method alone does not ensure continued service.
